info.title: Claims
info.description: Endpoints for creating and tracking Ship with Walmart (SWW) shipment-protection claims.

post.description: Creates a shipment-protection claim. Send multipart/form-data with files, documentTypes, and payload.

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: The access token retrieved in the Token API call.

parameters.name: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE
parameters.description: A unique ID to track the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding.

parameters.name: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID
parameters.description: A unique ID which identifies each API call and is used to track and debug issues; use a randomly generated GUID for this ID.

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Walmart service name—for Marketplace APIs simply use `Walmart Service Name` or the service identifier provided by Walmart.

files.description: One or more supporting files (images, PDFs, etc.).

documentTypes.description: Maps each uploaded file to its document category.

items.description: Object describing a single uploaded document.

purchaseOrderNo.description: Marketplace purchase-order number associated with the item in this claim.

purchaseOrderLineNo.description: Line number within the purchase order that maps to the claimed SKU.

salesOrderNo.description: Customer sales-order number for the shipment.

salesOrderLineNo.description: Line number within the sales order that maps to the claimed SKU.

fulfillerLineId.description: Identifier for the fulfiller’s line item in the warehouse/fulfillment center manifest.

quantity.description: Number of units being claimed for this line.

returnOrderId.description: Return-order ID that triggered or is linked to the claim.

claimType.description: Claim category: LIT (lost in transit), LAD (lost after delivery), or DAMAGED.

notes.description: Free-form claim notes from the seller.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of claims, with optional filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return in the response page (default 25, maximum 300).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero‑based index of the first result to return (default 0). Use together with `limit` for pagination.

parameters.name: claimsGroup
parameters.description: Filter claims by broad status group: OPEN, ACTION_NEEDED, or CLOSED.

parameters.name: claimNumber
parameters.description: Exact claim number for filtering (query) or identifying a specific claim (path).

parameters.name: purchaseOrderId
parameters.description: Filter by the Walmart purchase order ID associated with the claim.

parameters.name: trackingNo
parameters.description: Filter by the package tracking number associated with the claim.

parameters.name: claimTypes
parameters.description: Comma‑separated list of claim types to include (LIT, LAD, DAMAGED).

parameters.name: claimStatuses
parameters.description: Comma‑separated list of claim status codes to include (INITIATED, IN_REVIEW, NEED_INFO, etc.).

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by; currently supports `claimDate`.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction: `ASC` for ascending or `DESC` for descending (default DESC).
